record.field: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَحْيَانَا بَعْدَ مَا أَمَاتَنَا وَإِلَيْهِ النُّشُورُ
الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَحْيَانَا بَعْدَ مَا أَمَاتَنَا وَإِلَيْهِ النُّشُورُ
All praise is for Allah who gave us life after having taken it from us and unto Him is the resurrection.
Alhamdu lillahil-ladhi ahyana ba'da ma amatana wa ilayhin-nushur.
This dhikr is recited upon waking and praises Allah for the blessing of life each new morning.

اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ، وَأَنَا عَلَى عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ، أَبُوءُ لَكَ بِنِعْمَتِكَ عَلَيَّ، وَأَبُوءُ لَكَ بِذَنْبِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي، فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ

اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ، وَأَنَا عَلَى عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ، أَبُوءُ لَكَ بِنِعْمَتِكَ عَلَيَّ، وَأَبُوءُ لَكَ بِذَنْبِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي، فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ

O Allah, You are my Lord, there is none worthy of worship but You. You created me and I am your servant, and I am upon your covenant and promise as best I can. I seek refuge in You from the evil of what I have done. I acknowledge Your blessings upon me and I acknowledge my sin, so forgive me. For indeed, no one forgives sins except You.

Allahumma anta rabbi la ilaha illa anta, khalaqtani wa ana abduka, wa ana ala ahdika wa wa'dika mastata'tu, a'udhu bika min sharri ma sana'tu, abu'u laka bini'matika alayya, wa abu'u laka bidhanbi faghfir li, fa innahu la yaghfiru dhunuba illa ant.

The Prophet (PBUH) said: Whoever recites this with certainty in the morning and dies that day before evening will be among the people of Paradise, and whoever recites it with certainty in the evening and dies that night will be among the people of Paradise.
أَصْبَحْنَا وَأَصْبَحَ الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
أَصْبَحْنَا وَأَصْبَحَ الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ

We have reached the morning and at this very time all sovereignty belongs to Allah. All praise is for Allah. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner. To Him belongs all sovereignty and praise, and He is over all things omnipotent.
Asbahna wa asbahal mulku lillah, walhamdu lillah, la ilaha illallah wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul mulku walahul hamd, wa huwa ala kulli shay'in qadir.
This supplication acknowledges Allah's complete sovereignty at the start of the day.
اللَّهُمَّ بِكَ أَصْبَحْنَا، وَبِكَ أَمْسَيْنَا، وَبِكَ نَحْيَا، وَبِكَ نَمُوتُ، وَإِلَيْكَ النُّشُورُ
اللَّهُمَّ بِكَ أَصْبَحْنَا، وَبِكَ أَمْسَيْنَا، وَبِكَ نَحْيَا، وَبِكَ نَمُوتُ، وَإِلَيْكَ النُّشُورُ
O Allah, by You we enter the morning and by You we enter the evening, by You we live and by You we die, and to You is the resurrection.
Allahumma bika asbahna wa bika amsayna, wa bika nahya wa bika namutu wa ilaykan-nushur.
Affirms complete reliance on Allah for life, death, and the hereafter.
Glory be to Allah and praise be to Him.

The Prophet (PBUH) said: Whoever says this 100 times in the morning and 100 times in the evening will not be surpassed on the Day of Resurrection by anyone doing better than him, except one who said the same or more.

اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ ۚ لَا تَأْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلَا نَوْمٌ ۚ لَهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ ۗ مَنْ ذَا الَّذِي يَشْفَعُ عِنْدَهُ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِ ۚ يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ ۖ وَلَا يُحِيطُونَ بِشَيْءٍ مِنْ عِلْمِهِ إِلَّا بِمَا شَاءَ ۚ وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ ۖ وَلَا يَئُودُهُ حِفْظُهُمَا ۚ وَهُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيمُ

Allah - there is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of existence. Neither drowsiness overtakes Him nor sleep. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Who is it that can intercede with Him except by His permission? He knows what is before them and what will be after them, and they encompass not a thing of His knowledge except for what He wills. His Kursi extends over the heavens and the earth, and their preservation tires Him not. And He is the Most High, the Most Great. [Quran 2:255]

Allahu la ilaha illa huwal hayyul qayyum, la ta'khudhuhu sinatun wa la nawm, lahu ma fis-samawati wa ma fil-ard, man dhal-ladhi yashfa'u indahu illa bi-idhnih, ya'lamu ma bayna aydihim wa ma khalfahum, wa la yuhituna bishay'in min ilmihi illa bima sha', wasi'a kursiyyuhus-samawati wal-ard, wa la ya'uduhu hifdhuhuma wa huwal aliyyul adhim.
Whoever recites Ayat al-Kursi every morning will be under the protection of Allah until the evening, and whoever recites it every evening will be under the protection of Allah until the morning.
قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ، اللَّهُ الصَّمَدُ، لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ، وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌ
Say: He is Allah, the One. Allah, the Eternal Refuge. He neither begets nor is born. Nor is there to Him any equivalent. [Surah Al-Ikhlas]
Qul huwallahu ahad, Allahus-samad, lam yalid wa lam yulad, wa lam yakun lahu kufuwan ahad.
Reciting Al-Ikhlas, Al-Falaq, and An-Nas three times each morning and evening is sufficient protection against everything.
قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ، مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ، وَمِن شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ، وَمِن شَرِّ النَّفَّاثَاتِ فِي الْعُقَدِ، وَمِن شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ

Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak. From the evil of that which He created. And from the evil of darkness when it settles. And from the evil of the blowers in knots. And from the evil of an envier when he envies. [Surah Al-Falaq]
Qul a'udhu bi rabbil falaq, min sharri ma khalaq, wa min sharri ghasiqin idha waqab, wa min sharrin naffathati fil uqad, wa min sharri hasidin idha hasad.
This surah provides protection from evil, darkness, magic, and envy.
قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ، مَلِكِ النَّاسِ، إِلَٰهِ النَّاسِ، مِن شَرِّ الْوَسْوَاسِ الْخَنَّاسِ، الَّذِي يُوَسْوِسُ فِي صُدُورِ النَّاسِ، مِنَ الْجِنَّةِ وَالنَّاسِ

Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind. The Sovereign of mankind. The God of mankind. From the evil of the retreating whisperer - who whispers into the breasts of mankind - from among the jinn and mankind. [Surah An-Nas]
Qul a'udhu bi rabbin nas, malikin nas, ilahin nas, min sharril waswasil khannas, alladhi yuwaswisu fi sudurin nas, minal jinnati wan nas.
This surah provides protection from the whisperings of Shaytan and evil from jinn and mankind.
Morning Dua for Goodness of the Day
اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ هَذَا الْيَوْمِ، فَتْحَهُ، وَنَصْرَهُ، وَنُورَهُ، وَبَرَكَتَهُ، وَهُدَاهُ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا فِيهِ وَشَرِّ مَا بَعْدَهُ
اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ هَذَا الْيَوْمِ، فَتْحَهُ، وَنَصْرَهُ، وَنُورَهُ، وَبَرَكَتَهُ، وَهُدَاهُ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا فِيهِ وَشَرِّ مَا بَعْدَهُ
O Allah, I ask You for the goodness of this day, its victory, its light, its blessings, and its guidance. And I seek refuge in You from the evil in it and the evil that comes after it.
Allahumma inni as'aluka khayra hadhal yawm, fathahu wa nasrahu wa nurahu wa barakatahu wa hudahu, wa a'udhu bika min sharri ma fihi wa sharri ma ba'dahu.
A comprehensive supplication seeking all good of the day and protection from its evils.
الصلاة على النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى نَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ
اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى نَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ
O Allah, send prayers, peace, and blessings upon our Prophet Muhammad.
Allahumma salli wa sallim wa barik ala nabiyyina Muhammad.
Whoever sends salawat upon the Prophet (PBUH) once, Allah will send ten blessings upon him.
اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ عِلْمًا نَافِعًا، وَرِزْقًا طَيِّبًا، وَعَمَلًا مُتَقَبَّلًا
اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ عِلْمًا نَافِعًا، وَرِزْقًا طَيِّبًا، وَعَمَلًا مُتَقَبَّلًا
O Allah, I ask You for beneficial knowledge, pure provision, and accepted deeds.
Allahumma inni as'aluka ilman nafi'an, wa rizqan tayyiban, wa amalan mutaqabbalan.
This is a morning supplication recommended after Fajr prayer asking for the three great gifts: beneficial knowledge, pure provision, and accepted deeds.
أَصْبَحْتُ أَشْهَدُ أَنَّكَ إِنْ كُنْتَ أَنْزَلْتَ عَلَى عِيسَى رُوحًا مِّنكَ وَكَلِمَةً أَلْقَيْتَهَا إِلَى مَرْيَمَ، فَمُحَمَّدٌ عَبْدُكَ وَرَسُولُكَ
I bear witness in the morning that if You revealed to Jesus a spirit from You and a word which You conveyed to Mary, then Muhammad is Your servant and Your messenger.
Asbahtu ashhadu annaka in kunta anzalta ala Isa ruhan minka wa kalimatan alqaytaha ila Maryam, fa Muhammadun abduka wa rasuluk.
A powerful testimony of faith affirming the prophethood of Muhammad (PBUH).
Morning Dua for Health and Well-Being
اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي دِينِي وَدُنْيَايَ وَأَهْلِي وَمَالِي
اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي دِينِي وَدُنْيَايَ وَأَهْلِي وَمَالِي
O Allah, I ask You for pardon and well-being in this world and the next. O Allah, I ask You for pardon and well-being in my religious and worldly affairs, in my family and my wealth.
Allahumma inni as'alukal afwa wal afiyata fid-dunya wal-akhirah. Allahumma inni as'alukal afwa wal afiyata fi dini wa dunyaya wa ahli wa mali.
The Prophet (PBUH) said that after certainty in faith, no one has been given anything better than well-being.
رَضِيتُ بِاللَّهِ رَبًّا، وَبِالإِسْلامِ دِينًا، وَبِمُحَمَّدٍ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَبِيًّا
رَضِيتُ بِاللَّهِ رَبًّا، وَبِالإِسْلامِ دِينًا، وَبِمُحَمَّدٍ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَبِيًّا
I am pleased with Allah as my Lord, with Islam as my religion, and with Muhammad (peace be upon him) as my Prophet.
Raditu billahi rabban, wa bil-islami dinan, wa bi-Muhammadin sallallahu alayhi wa sallama nabiyyan.
The Prophet (PBUH) said: Whoever says this three times in the morning and evening, it is a right upon Allah to please him on the Day of Resurrection.

أَمْسَيْنَا وَأَمْسَى الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ

We have entered the evening and at this very time all sovereignty belongs to Allah. All praise is for Allah. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner. To Him belongs all sovereignty and praise, and He is over all things omnipotent.

Acknowledges Allah's complete sovereignty at the end of the day.

Evening Dua for Forgiveness and Well-Being
اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي دِينِي وَدُنْيَايَ وَأَهْلِي وَمَالِي
O Allah, I ask You for pardon and well-being in this world and the next. O Allah, I ask You for pardon and well-being in my religious and worldly affairs, and in my family and my wealth.
Allahumma inni as'alukal afwa wal afiyata fid-dunya wal-akhirah. Allahumma inni as'alukal afwa wal afiyata fi dini wa dunyaya wa ahli wa mali.
One of the most comprehensive supplications for worldly and spiritual well-being.
اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ، وَمِنْ عَذَابِ النَّارِ، وَمِنْ فِتْنَةِ الْمَحْيَا وَالْمَمَاتِ، وَمِنْ فِتْنَةِ الْمَسِيحِ الدَّجَّالِ
اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ، وَمِنْ عَذَابِ النَّارِ، وَمِنْ فِتْنَةِ الْمَحْيَا وَالْمَمَاتِ، وَمِنْ فِتْنَةِ الْمَسِيحِ الدَّجَّالِ
O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the punishment of the grave, from the punishment of the Fire, from the trials of life and death, and from the trial of the false messiah.
Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min adhabil qabr, wa min adhabil nar, wa min fitnatil mahya wal mamat, wa min fitnatil masihid dajjal.
Seeking refuge from the four great trials in this life and the next.
لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
There is none worthy of worship but Allah alone. He has no partner. To Him belongs the dominion, to Him belongs all praise, He gives life and causes death, and He is over all things omnipotent.
La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul mulku walahul hamdu yuhyi wa yumitu wa huwa ala kulli shay'in qadir.
Whoever says this 10 times in the evening, Allah will record for him 10 good deeds, erase 10 bad deeds, raise him 10 degrees, and it will be a protection for him until the morning.
حَسْبِيَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَهُوَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ
حَسْبِيَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَهُوَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ
Allah is sufficient for me. There is none worthy of worship but Him. I have placed my trust in Him, and He is the Lord of the Majestic Throne.
Hasbiyallahu la ilaha illa huwa, alayhi tawakkaltu wa huwa rabbul arshil adhim.
The Prophet (PBUH) said: Whoever says this 7 times morning and evening, Allah will be sufficient for him in whatever worries him.
Evening Seeking Good of the Night
اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ هَذِهِ اللَّيْلَةِ وَخَيْرَ مَا فِيهَا، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهَا وَشَرِّ مَا فِيهَا
اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ هَذِهِ اللَّيْلَةِ وَخَيْرَ مَا فِيهَا، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهَا وَشَرِّ مَا فِيهَا
O Allah, I ask You for the good of this night and the good that it contains, and I seek refuge in You from its evil and the evil that it contains.
Allahumma inni as'aluka khayra hadhihil laylati wa khayra ma fiha, wa a'udhu bika min sharriha wa sharri ma fiha.
A comprehensive supplication for the goodness of the night.
رَّبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَلِوَالِدَيَّ وَارْحَمْهُمَا كَمَا رَبَّيَانِي صَغِيرًا
رَّبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَلِوَالِدَيَّ وَارْحَمْهُمَا كَمَا رَبَّيَانِي صَغِيرًا
My Lord, forgive me and my parents and have mercy upon them as they raised me when I was small.
Rabbighfir li wa liwaalidayya warhamhuma kama rabbayaani saghiran.
A Quranic supplication for forgiveness for oneself and one's parents.
I seek forgiveness from Allah and repent to Him.
The Prophet (PBUH) used to say this 100 times a day. Constant istighfar opens the doors of provision and relief.
اللَّهُمَّ احْفَظْنِي مِنْ بَيْنِ يَدَيَّ وَمِنْ خَلْفِي وَعَنْ يَمِينِي وَعَنْ شِمَالِي وَمِنْ فَوْقِي وَأَعُوذُ بِعَظَمَتِكَ أَنْ أُغْتَالَ مِنْ تَحْتِي
اللَّهُمَّ احْفَظْنِي مِنْ بَيْنِ يَدَيَّ وَمِنْ خَلْفِي وَعَنْ يَمِينِي وَعَنْ شِمَالِي وَمِنْ فَوْقِي وَأَعُوذُ بِعَظَمَتِكَ أَنْ أُغْتَالَ مِنْ تَحْتِي
O Allah, protect me from my front and from my back, from my right and from my left, and from above me, and I seek refuge in Your greatness from being swallowed from beneath me.
Allahumma hfazni min bayni yadayya wa min khalfi wa an yamini wa an shimali wa min fawqi wa a'udhu bi'adhamatika an ughtala min tahti.
A comprehensive protection supplication for all directions.
اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى نَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ
O Allah, send prayers, peace, and blessings upon our Prophet Muhammad.
Allahumma salli wa sallim wa barik ala nabiyyina Muhammad.
Whoever sends salawat upon the Prophet (PBUH) once, Allah will send ten blessings upon him.
The Prophet (PBUH) used to say Astaghfirullah three times after completing the prayer.
اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ السَّلَامُ وَمِنْكَ السَّلَامُ، تَبَارَكْتَ يَا ذَا الْجَلَالِ وَالإِكْرَامِ
اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ السَّلَامُ وَمِنْكَ السَّلَامُ، تَبَارَكْتَ يَا ذَا الْجَلَالِ وَالإِكْرَامِ
O Allah, You are the Peace and from You is peace. Blessed are You, O Possessor of majesty and honor.
Allahumma antas-salam wa minkas-salam, tabarakta ya dhal jalali wal ikram.
Recited after giving the tasleem (salam) at the end of each prayer.
The Prophet (PBUH) instructed to say Subhanallah 33 times, Alhamdulillah 33 times, and Allahu Akbar 33 times after each prayer — totaling 99, and completing 100 with La ilaha illallah.
Part of the post-prayer tasbih. Sins fall away like leaves from a tree for those who glorify, praise, and exalt Allah after prayer.
Part of the blessed post-prayer tasbih (33 each).
لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner. To Him belongs all sovereignty and praise, and He is over all things omnipotent.
La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul mulku walahul hamdu wa huwa ala kulli shay'in qadir.
Said after 33 Subhanallah, 33 Alhamdulillah, 33 Allahu Akbar. Sins are forgiven even if they are like the foam of the sea for whoever says this.
اللَّهُمَّ أَعِنِّي عَلَى ذِكْرِكَ وَشُكْرِكَ وَحُسْنِ عِبَادَتِكَ
اللَّهُمَّ أَعِنِّي عَلَى ذِكْرِكَ وَشُكْرِكَ وَحُسْنِ عِبَادَتِكَ
O Allah, help me to remember You, to be grateful to You, and to worship You in an excellent manner.
Allahumma a'inni ala dhikrika wa shukrika wa husni ibadatik.
The Prophet (PBUH) advised Mu'adh ibn Jabal to say this at the end of every prayer.
اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ ۚ لَا تَأْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلَا نَوْمٌ
Allah - there is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of existence. Neither drowsiness overtakes Him nor sleep. [Quran 2:255]
Allahu la ilaha illa huwal hayyul qayyum, la ta'khudhuhu sinatun wa la nawm...
Whoever recites Ayat al-Kursi after every obligatory prayer, nothing will prevent him from entering Paradise except death.
Dua for Protection from Four Things
اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْجُبْنِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنْ أُرَدَّ إِلَى أَرْذَلِ الْعُمُرِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ فِتْنَةِ الدُّنْيَا، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ
اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْجُبْنِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنْ أُرَدَّ إِلَى أَرْذَلِ الْعُمُرِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ فِتْنَةِ الدُّنْيَا، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ

O Allah, I seek refuge in You from cowardice, and I seek refuge in You from being returned to a decrepit old age, and I seek refuge in You from the tribulation of the world, and I seek refuge in You from the punishment of the grave.
Allahumma inni a'udhu bika minal jubn, wa a'udhu bika an uradda ila ardhali'l umr, wa a'udhu bika min fitnatid dunya, wa a'udhu bika min adhabil qabr.
Seeking refuge from four of the major spiritual and worldly harms.
اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْجَنَّةَ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ النَّارِ
اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْجَنَّةَ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ النَّارِ
O Allah, I ask You for Paradise and I seek refuge in You from the Fire.
Allahumma inni as'alukal jannata wa a'udhu bika minan nar.
Jannah will say O Allah enter him, and Jahannam will say O Allah protect him from me, for whoever asks for Jannah 3 times and seeks refuge from the Fire 3 times.
In Your name, O Allah, I die and I live.
The Prophet (PBUH) used to say this when going to sleep, understanding sleep as a minor death and waking as new life from Allah.
Sleep Recitation of Al-Ikhlas, Al-Falaq, An-Nas
قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ، اللَّهُ الصَّمَدُ، لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ، وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌ
Say: He is Allah, the One, the Eternal Refuge. He neither begets nor is born. Nor is there to Him any equivalent. [Surah Al-Ikhlas - then recite Al-Falaq and An-Nas]
Qul huwallahu ahad, Allahus-samad, lam yalid wa lam yulad, wa lam yakun lahu kufuwan ahad.
The Prophet (PBUH) used to blow into his cupped hands after reciting these three surahs and wipe his body. This protects against all harm during sleep.

اللَّهُمَّ أَسْلَمْتُ نَفْسِي إِلَيْكَ، وَفَوَّضْتُ أَمْرِي إِلَيْكَ، وَوَجَّهْتُ وَجْهِي إِلَيْكَ، وَأَلْجَأْتُ ظَهْرِي إِلَيْكَ، رَغْبَةً وَرَهْبَةً إِلَيْكَ، لَا مَلْجَأَ وَلَا مَنْجَا مِنْكَ إِلَّا إِلَيْكَ، آمَنْتُ بِكِتَابِكَ الَّذِي أَنْزَلْتَ وَبِنَبِيِّكَ الَّذِي أَرْسَلْتَ

اللَّهُمَّ أَسْلَمْتُ نَفْسِي إِلَيْكَ، وَفَوَّضْتُ أَمْرِي إِلَيْكَ، وَوَجَّهْتُ وَجْهِي إِلَيْكَ، وَأَلْجَأْتُ ظَهْرِي إِلَيْكَ، رَغْبَةً وَرَهْبَةً إِلَيْكَ، لَا مَلْجَأَ وَلَا مَنْجَا مِنْكَ إِلَّا إِلَيْكَ، آمَنْتُ بِكِتَابِكَ الَّذِي أَنْزَلْتَ وَبِنَبِيِّكَ الَّذِي أَرْسَلْتَ

O Allah, I submit myself to You, entrust my affairs to You, turn my face to You, and lay myself down depending upon You, hoping in You and fearing You. There is no refuge and no escape from You except to You. I believe in Your book which You revealed and in Your Prophet whom You sent.

Allahumma aslamtu nafsi ilayk, wa fawwadtu amri ilayk, wa wajjahtu wajhi ilayk, wa alja'tu dhahri ilayk, raghbatan wa rahbatan ilayk, la malja'a wa la manja minka illa ilayk, amantu bikitabikalladhi anzalta wa binabiyyikalladhi arsalt.
The Prophet (PBUH) said: If you die that night you will die upon the fitrah (natural disposition of Islam). Make this the last thing you say.
سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ (٣٣)، الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ (٣٣)، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ (٣٤)
سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ (٣٣)، الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ (٣٣)، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ (٣٤)
Glory be to Allah (33 times), All praise is to Allah (33 times), Allah is the Greatest (34 times).
The Prophet (PBUH) said this is better for you than having a servant. It will give you strength for the next day.

آمَنَ الرَّسُولُ بِمَا أُنزِلَ إِلَيْهِ مِن رَّبِّهِ وَالْمُؤْمِنُونَ ۚ كُلٌّ آمَنَ بِاللَّهِ وَمَلَائِكَتِهِ وَكُتُبِهِ وَرُسُلِهِ لَا نُفَرِّقُ بَيْنَ أَحَدٍ مِّن رُّسُلِهِ ۚ وَقَالُوا سَمِعْنَا وَأَطَعْنَا ۖ غُفْرَانَكَ رَبَّنَا وَإِلَيْكَ الْمَصِيرُ

The Messenger has believed in what was revealed to him from his Lord, and so have the believers. All of them have believed in Allah and His angels and His books and His messengers, saying: We make no distinction between any of His messengers. And they say: We hear and we obey. Grant us Your forgiveness, our Lord, and to You is the final destination. [Quran 2:285]

Aamanar rasulu bima unzila ilayhi mir rabbihi wal mu'minun, kullun amana billahi wa mala'ikatihi wa kutubihi wa rusulihi la nufarriqu bayna ahadin mir rusulihi wa qalu sami'na wa ata'na ghufranaka rabbana wa ilaykal masir.
The Prophet (PBUH) said: Whoever recites the last two verses of Surah Al-Baqarah at night, they will be sufficient for him (as protection).
اللَّهُمَّ قِنِي عَذَابَكَ يَوْمَ تَبْعَثُ عِبَادَكَ
اللَّهُمَّ قِنِي عَذَابَكَ يَوْمَ تَبْعَثُ عِبَادَكَ
O Allah, protect me from Your punishment on the day You resurrect Your servants.
Allahumma qini adhabaka yawma tab'athu ibadak.
Said three times before sleeping as protection and a reminder of the Day of Judgment.
اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ وَمِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ حَيَوَانٍ أَنْتَ آخِذٌ بِنَاصِيَتِهِ
O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the accursed devil and from the evil of every creature You have control over.
Allahumma inni a'udhu bika minash-shaytanir rajim wa min sharri kulli hayawanin anta akhidhun binasiyatih.
Protection from Shaytan and nightmares during sleep.
تَبَارَكَ الَّذِي بِيَدِهِ الْمُلْكُ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
Blessed is He in whose hand is dominion, and He is over all things competent. [Opening of Surah Al-Mulk - recite the entire surah]
Tabarakal ladhi biyadihil mulku wa huwa ala kulli shay'in qadir...
The Prophet (PBUH) said he would not sleep until he recited Surah Al-Mulk. It intercedes for its reciter until he is forgiven and protects from the punishment of the grave.
الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَحْيَانَا بَعْدَ مَا أَمَاتَنَا وَإِلَيْهِ النُّشُورُ
الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَحْيَانَا بَعْدَ مَا أَمَاتَنَا وَإِلَيْهِ النُّشُورُ
All praise is for Allah who gave us life after having taken it from us and unto Him is the resurrection.
Alhamdu lillahil-ladhi ahyana ba'da ma amatana wa ilayhin-nushur.
The first words upon waking, praising Allah for the gift of a new day.
لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ وَهُوَ حَيٌّ لَا يَمُوتُ، بِيَدِهِ الْخَيْرُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ وَهُوَ حَيٌّ لَا يَمُوتُ، بِيَدِهِ الْخَيْرُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ

None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner. To Him belongs all sovereignty and all praise. He gives life and causes death, and He is Ever-Living and will not die. In His hand is all goodness and He is over all things omnipotent.
La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul mulku walahul hamdu, yuhyi wa yumitu wa huwa hayyun la yamut, biyadihil khayru wa huwa ala kulli shay'in qadir.
Recited while wiping sleep from the face upon waking as a form of dhikr.
بِسْمِ اللَّهِ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْخُبُثِ وَالْخَبَائِثِ
بِسْمِ اللَّهِ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْخُبُثِ وَالْخَبَائِثِ
In the name of Allah. O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the male and female evil ones (jinn).
Bismillah. Allahumma inni a'udhu bika minal khubuthi wal khaba'ith.
Said before entering the bathroom to seek protection from evil jinn.
Said upon exiting the bathroom. The Prophet (PBUH) consistently did this, and it is a sunnah muakkadah.
Dua for Starting the Day with Intention
اللَّهُمَّ بِكَ أَصْبَحْنَا وَبِكَ أَمْسَيْنَا وَبِكَ نَحْيَا وَبِكَ نَمُوتُ وَإِلَيْكَ الْمَصِيرُ
اللَّهُمَّ بِكَ أَصْبَحْنَا وَبِكَ أَمْسَيْنَا وَبِكَ نَحْيَا وَبِكَ نَمُوتُ وَإِلَيْكَ الْمَصِيرُ
O Allah, by You we enter the morning and by You we enter the evening. By You we live and by You we die, and to You is the destination.
Allahumma bika asbahna wa bika amsayna wa bika nahya wa bika namutu wa ilaykal masir.
A reminder upon waking that all affairs belong to Allah.
اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ الْمَوْلِجِ وَخَيْرَ الْمَخْرَجِ، بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَلَجْنَا وَبِسْمِ اللَّهِ خَرَجْنَا وَعَلَى اللَّهِ رَبِّنَا تَوَكَّلْنَا
اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ الْمَوْلِجِ وَخَيْرَ الْمَخْرَجِ، بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَلَجْنَا وَبِسْمِ اللَّهِ خَرَجْنَا وَعَلَى اللَّهِ رَبِّنَا تَوَكَّلْنَا
O Allah, I ask You for the good of the entry and the good of the exit. In the name of Allah we enter and in the name of Allah we leave, and in Allah our Lord we put our trust.
Allahumma inni as'aluka khayral mawlaji wa khayral makhraj, bismillahi walajnaa wa bismillahi kharajnaa wa alallahi rabbinaa tawakkalna.
Said when entering the home to bring blessings and protection.
بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللَّهِ، وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللَّهِ، وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
In the name of Allah, I place my trust in Allah, and there is no might nor power except with Allah.
Bismillah, tawakkaltu alallah, wa la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah.
When a person says this upon leaving home, it is said to him: You are guided, defended, and protected, and shaytan stays away from him.
The Prophet (PBUH) said: When one of you eats food, let him say Bismillah. If he forgets in the beginning, let him say: Bismillahi fi awwalihi wa akhirih.
الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَطْعَمَنَا وَسَقَانَا وَجَعَلَنَا مُسْلِمِينَ
الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَطْعَمَنَا وَسَقَانَا وَجَعَلَنَا مُسْلِمِينَ
All praise is for Allah who fed us and gave us drink, and made us Muslims.
Alhamdulillahil-ladhi at'amana wa saqana wa ja'alana muslimin.
Gratitude to Allah after every meal is a beloved act and increases blessings in provision.
O Allah, open for me the gates of Your mercy.
Said upon entering the masjid with the right foot. Seeking Allah's mercy at His house of worship.
O Allah, I ask You for Your bounty.
Said upon leaving the masjid with the left foot, asking Allah for provisions and bounty in the worldly life.
لَّا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ
لَّا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ
There is no deity except You; exalted are You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers.
La ilaha illa anta subhanaka inni kuntu minadh dhalimin.
The Prophet (PBUH) said: The supplication of Dhun-Nun (Yunus) - no Muslim supplicates with it for anything except that Allah responds to him.

اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي عَبْدُكَ، ابْنُ عَبْدِكَ، ابْنُ أَمَتِكَ، نَاصِيَتِي بِيَدِكَ، مَاضٍ فِيَّ حُكْمُكَ، عَدْلٌ فِيَّ قَضَاؤُكَ، أَسْأَلُكَ بِكُلِّ اسْمٍ هُوَ لَكَ سَمَّيْتَ بِهِ نَفْسَكَ، أَوْ أَنْزَلْتَهُ فِي كِتَابِكَ، أَوْ عَلَّمْتَهُ أَحَداً مِنْ خَلْقِكَ، أَوِ اسْتَأْثَرْتَ بِهِ فِي عِلْمِ الْغَيْبِ عِنْدَكَ، أَنْ تَجْعَلَ الْقُرْآنَ رَبِيعَ قَلْبِي، وَنُورَ صَدْرِي، وَجِلَاءَ حُزْنِي، وَذَهَابَ هَمِّي

O Allah, I am Your servant, the son of Your servant, the son of your maidservant. My forelock is in Your hand. Your command over me is forever executed and Your decree over me is just. I ask You by every name belonging to You which You have named Yourself with, or revealed in Your Book, or You taught to any of Your creation, or You have preserved in the knowledge of the Unseen with You, that You make the Quran the spring of my heart and the light of my chest, and a departure for my sorrow and a release for my anxiety.

Allahumma inni abduka, ibnu abdika, ibnu amatika, nasiyati biyadik, madin fiyya hukmuk, adlun fiyya qada'uk, as'aluka bikulli ismin huwa laka sammayta bihi nafsak, aw anzaltahu fi kitabik, aw allamtahu ahadan min khalqik, awista'tharta bihi fi ilmil ghaybi indak, an taj'alal qur'ana rabi'a qalbi, wa nura sadri, wa jila'a huzni, wa dhahaba hammi.
The Prophet (PBUH) said: Allah will take away his grief and replace it with joy for whoever says this.
سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ وَإِنَّا إِلَى رَبِّنَا لَمُنقَلِبُونَ
سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ وَإِنَّا إِلَى رَبِّنَا لَمُنقَلِبُونَ
Glory be to Him who has subjected this to us and we could never have it by our efforts, and indeed to our Lord we are returning.
Subhanalladhi sakhkhara lana hadha wa ma kunna lahu muqrinin wa inna ila rabbina lamunqalibun.
Said when boarding any vehicle or transport as gratitude to Allah for subjecting it to us.

اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْتَخِيرُكَ بِعِلْمِكَ وَأَسْتَقْدِرُكَ بِقُدْرَتِكَ وَأَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ الْعَظِيمِ، فَإِنَّكَ تَقْدِرُ وَلَا أَقْدِرُ وَتَعْلَمُ وَلَا أَعْلَمُ وَأَنْتَ عَلَّامُ الْغُيُوبِ

اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْتَخِيرُكَ بِعِلْمِكَ وَأَسْتَقْدِرُكَ بِقُدْرَتِكَ وَأَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ الْعَظِيمِ، فَإِنَّكَ تَقْدِرُ وَلَا أَقْدِرُ وَتَعْلَمُ وَلَا أَعْلَمُ وَأَنْتَ عَلَّامُ الْغُيُوبِ

O Allah, I seek Your counsel by Your knowledge and by Your power I seek strength, and I ask You from Your immense favour, for verily You are able and I am not, and You know and I know not. You are the Knower of hidden things.
Allahumma inni astakhiruka bi ilmik, wa astaqdiruka bi qudratik, wa as'aluka min fadlikal adhim, fa innaka taqdiru wa la aqdiru, wa ta'lamu wa la a'lamu wa anta allamul ghuyub.
The full istikhara prayer is 2 raka'at followed by this supplication. Said when facing an important decision.
Said when rain falls. The Prophet (PBUH) said dua is accepted when it rains, so this is an excellent time for supplication.
سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي يُسَبِّحُ الرَّعْدُ بِحَمْدِهِ وَالْمَلَائِكَةُ مِنْ خِيفَتِهِ
سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي يُسَبِّحُ الرَّعْدُ بِحَمْدِهِ وَالْمَلَائِكَةُ مِنْ خِيفَتِهِ
Glory be to Him Whom thunder glorifies with His praise, and the angels from fear of Him.
Subhanalladhi yusabbihur ra'du bihamdihi wal mala'ikatu min khifatih.
Recited when hearing thunder, reminding us that all creation glorifies Allah.

Said after sneezing. The one who hears it replies: Yarhamukallah (May Allah have mercy on you), and the sneezer says: Yahdiikumullahu wa yuslihu balakum (May Allah guide you and set your affairs right).
لَا بَأْسَ طَهُورٌ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ
لَا بَأْسَ طَهُورٌ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ
Do not worry, it (the illness) is a purification, if Allah wills.
La ba'sa tahurun in sha Allah.
Said when visiting someone who is sick, giving them comfort that illness expiates sins.
اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ النَّاسِ، أَذْهِبِ الْبَاسَ، اشْفِهِ وَأَنْتَ الشَّافِي، لَا شِفَاءَ إِلَّا شِفَاؤُكَ، شِفَاءً لَا يُغَادِرُ سَقَمًا
اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ النَّاسِ، أَذْهِبِ الْبَاسَ، اشْفِهِ وَأَنْتَ الشَّافِي، لَا شِفَاءَ إِلَّا شِفَاؤُكَ، شِفَاءً لَا يُغَادِرُ سَقَمًا
O Allah, Lord of mankind, remove the affliction and heal him, for You are the Healer. There is no healing except Your healing, a healing that leaves no illness behind.
Allahumma rabban nas, adhibil ba's, ishfihi wa antash shafi, la shifa'a illa shifa'uk, shifaan la yughadiru saqama.
Said while placing the hand on the sick person and making this supplication for their healing.
Dua Upon Seeing Someone in Trial
الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي عَافَانِي مِمَّا ابْتَلَاكَ بِهِ، وَفَضَّلَنِي عَلَى كَثِيرٍ مِمَّنْ خَلَقَ تَفْضِيلًا
الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي عَافَانِي مِمَّا ابْتَلَاكَ بِهِ، وَفَضَّلَنِي عَلَى كَثِيرٍ مِمَّنْ خَلَقَ تَفْضِيلًا
All praise is for Allah who saved me from that which He has afflicted you with, and blessed me greatly over many of those He has created.
Alhamdulillahil-ladhi afani mimma ibtalaka bihi, wa faddalani ala kathirin mimman khalaqa tafdila.
Said quietly when seeing someone afflicted with illness or hardship. The Prophet said this person will be protected from that trial.
الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي بِنِعْمَتِهِ تَتِمُّ الصَّالِحَاتُ
الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي بِنِعْمَتِهِ تَتِمُّ الصَّالِحَاتُ
All praise is for Allah by Whose favor good deeds are completed.
Said when something pleasing happens, attributing all good to Allah's grace.
All praise is for Allah in all circumstances.
Said during hardship, showing contentment and gratitude to Allah at all times.
اللَّهُمَّ اكْفِنِي بِحَلَالِكَ عَنْ حَرَامِكَ وَأَغْنِنِي بِفَضْلِكَ عَمَّنْ سِوَاكَ
اللَّهُمَّ اكْفِنِي بِحَلَالِكَ عَنْ حَرَامِكَ وَأَغْنِنِي بِفَضْلِكَ عَمَّنْ سِوَاكَ
O Allah, suffice me with what You have made lawful so that I have no need of what You have made unlawful, and enrich me by Your bounty so that I need no one besides You.
Allahumma akfini bihalilaka an haramika wa aghnini bifadlika amman siwak.
A beautiful supplication for sustenance from halal sources and independence from others.
لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ وَهُوَ حَيٌّ لَا يَمُوتُ، بِيَدِهِ الْخَيْرُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ وَهُوَ حَيٌّ لَا يَمُوتُ، بِيَدِهِ الْخَيْرُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ

None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner. To Him belongs all sovereignty and praise. He gives life and causes death, while He is Living and does not die. In His hand is all goodness, and He is over all things omnipotent.
La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul mulku walahul hamdu, yuhyi wa yumitu wa huwa hayyun la yamut, biyadihil khayru wa huwa ala kulli shay'in qadir.
The Prophet (PBUH) said: Whoever enters the market and says this, Allah will write for him one million good deeds, erase from him one million bad deeds, and raise him one million degrees.
اهْدِنَا الصِّرَاطَ الْمُسْتَقِيمَ، صِرَاطَ الَّذِينَ أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ غَيْرِ الْمَغْضُوبِ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا الضَّالِّينَ
اهْدِنَا الصِّرَاطَ الْمُسْتَقِيمَ، صِرَاطَ الَّذِينَ أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ غَيْرِ الْمَغْضُوبِ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا الضَّالِّينَ
Guide us to the straight path - the path of those upon whom You have bestowed favor, not of those who have earned Your anger, nor of those who are astray.
Ihdinas siratal mustaqim, siratal ladhina an'amta alayhim ghayril maghdubi alayhim wa lad dallin.
The greatest supplication in the Quran, recited in every prayer. Asking Allah for guidance to the straight path.
Dua for Goodness in Both Worlds
دعاء ربنا آتنا في الدنيا حسنة
رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
Our Lord, give us in this world that which is good and in the Hereafter that which is good and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.
Rabbana atina fid dunya hasanatan wa fil akhirati hasanatan wa qina adhaaban nar.
The Prophet (PBUH) frequently made this supplication. It encompasses all the good of this world and the next in a few words.
رَبَّنَا ظَلَمْنَا أَنفُسَنَا وَإِن لَّمْ تَغْفِرْ لَنَا وَتَرْحَمْنَا لَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ الْخَاسِرِينَ
رَبَّنَا ظَلَمْنَا أَنفُسَنَا وَإِن لَّمْ تَغْفِرْ لَنَا وَتَرْحَمْنَا لَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ الْخَاسِرِينَ
Our Lord, we have wronged ourselves, and if You do not forgive us and have mercy upon us, we will surely be among the losers.
Rabbana dhalamna anfusana wa in lam taghfir lana wa tarhamna lanakunanna minal khasirin.
The supplication of Prophet Adam and Hawwa (Eve) when they sought forgiveness. A profound expression of humility before Allah.
رَبِّ اجْعَلْنِي مُقِيمَ الصَّلَاةِ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِي ۚ رَبَّنَا وَتَقَبَّلْ دُعَاءِ
رَبِّ اجْعَلْنِي مُقِيمَ الصَّلَاةِ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِي ۚ رَبَّنَا وَتَقَبَّلْ دُعَاءِ
My Lord, make me an establisher of prayer, and from my descendants. Our Lord, and accept my supplication.
Rabbi ij'alni muqimas salati wa min dhurriyyati, rabbana wa taqabbal du'a.
The supplication of Ibrahim (AS) for himself and his descendants to be steadfast in prayer — a beautiful dua for family.
رَبَّنَا أَفْرِغْ عَلَيْنَا صَبْرًا وَثَبِّتْ أَقْدَامَنَا وَانصُرْنَا عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِينَ
رَبَّنَا أَفْرِغْ عَلَيْنَا صَبْرًا وَثَبِّتْ أَقْدَامَنَا وَانصُرْنَا عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِينَ
Our Lord, pour upon us patience and plant firmly our feet and give us victory over the disbelieving people.
Rabbana afrigh alayna sabran wa thabbit aqdamana wansurna alal qawmil kafirin.
The supplication of the believers who faced Jalut (Goliath). A beautiful dua for patience and victory from Allah.
رَبَّنَا هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ أَزْوَاجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّاتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعْيُنٍ وَاجْعَلْنَا لِلْمُتَّقِينَ إِمَامًا
رَبَّنَا هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ أَزْوَاجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّاتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعْيُنٍ وَاجْعَلْنَا لِلْمُتَّقِينَ إِمَامًا
Our Lord, grant us from among our wives and offspring comfort to our eyes and make us an example for the righteous.
Rabbana hab lana min azwajina wa dhurriyyatina qurrata a'yunin waj'alna lil muttaqina imama.
The supplication of the servants of the Most Merciful for a righteous family and progeny.
رَبِّ إِنِّي لِمَا أَنزَلْتَ إِلَيَّ مِنْ خَيْرٍ فَقِيرٌ
رَبِّ إِنِّي لِمَا أَنزَلْتَ إِلَيَّ مِنْ خَيْرٍ فَقِيرٌ
My Lord, indeed I am, for whatever good You would send down to me, in need.
Rabbi inni lima anzalta ilayya min khayrin faqir.
The supplication of Prophet Musa (AS) when he was in dire need after fleeing Egypt. A humble acknowledgment of complete dependence on Allah.
رَبَّنَا لَا تُزِغْ قُلُوبَنَا بَعْدَ إِذْ هَدَيْتَنَا وَهَبْ لَنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ رَحْمَةً ۚ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ الْوَهَّابُ
رَبَّنَا لَا تُزِغْ قُلُوبَنَا بَعْدَ إِذْ هَدَيْتَنَا وَهَبْ لَنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ رَحْمَةً ۚ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ الْوَهَّابُ
Our Lord, let not our hearts deviate after You have guided us and grant us from Yourself mercy. Indeed, You are the Bestower.
Rabbana la tuzigh qulubana ba'da idh hadaytana wa hab lana mil ladunka rahmah, innaka antal wahhab.
A supplication asking Allah to keep our hearts firm upon guidance. One of the most important duas for protecting one's faith.
أَنِّي مَسَّنِيَ الضُّرُّ وَأَنتَ أَرْحَمُ الرَّاحِمِينَ
أَنِّي مَسَّنِيَ الضُّرُّ وَأَنتَ أَرْحَمُ الرَّاحِمِينَ
Indeed, adversity has touched me, and You are the Most Merciful of the merciful.
Anni massaniyad durru wa anta arhamur rahimin.
The supplication of Prophet Ayyub (AS) during his years of illness and hardship. Allah responded and relieved his suffering.

رَبَّنَا لَا تُؤَاخِذْنَا إِن نَّسِينَا أَوْ أَخْطَأْنَا ۚ رَبَّنَا وَلَا تَحْمِلْ عَلَيْنَا إِصْرًا كَمَا حَمَلْتَهُ عَلَى الَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِنَا ۚ رَبَّنَا وَلَا تُحَمِّلْنَا مَا لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا بِهِ ۖ وَاعْفُ عَنَّا وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَارْحَمْنَا ۚ أَنتَ مَوْلَانَا فَانصُرْنَا عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِينَ

Our Lord, do not impose blame upon us if we have forgotten or erred. Our Lord, and lay not upon us a burden like that which You laid upon those before us. Our Lord, and burden us not with that which we have no ability to bear. And pardon us; and forgive us; and have mercy upon us. You are our protector, so give us victory over the disbelieving people.

Rabbana la tu'akhidhna in nasina aw akhta'na, rabbana wa la tahmil alayna isran kama hamaltahu alal ladhina min qablina, rabbana wa la tuhammilna ma la taqata lana bih, wa'fu anna waghfir lana warhamna, anta mawlana fansurna alal qawmil kafirin.
The closing supplication of Surah Al-Baqarah. The Prophet (PBUH) was told by Jibreel that every ayah of this dua is accepted by Allah.
